GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "die Familie" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. grandfather
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. family
   D. father

2. What does "die Eltern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. daughter
   B. family
   C. friend
   D. parents

3. What does "die Lampe" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. kitchen
   B. lamp
   C. house
   D. garden

4. Which day comes right after Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Sonntag
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Montag
   D. Freitag

5. If today is Freitag, what is tomorrow? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Samstag
   C. Donnerstag
   D. Sonntag

6. In "Geburtstag", how do you say the letter "u"? (1 mark)
   A. like ow
   B. like oo
   C. like yoo
   D. like uh

7. What does "der Reis" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. apple
   B. sugar
   C. rice
   D. cabbage or kale

8. Which room do you link with "Ich dusche"? (1 mark)
   A. der Garten
   B. das Wohnzimmer
   C. das Badezimmer
   D. die Küche

9. How is the letter Q named in German? (1 mark)
   A. koo
   B. fow
   C. emm
   D. ee

10. How is the letter V named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ah
   B. fow
   C. hah
   D. ess

11. How is the letter L named in German? (1 mark)
   A. tsay
   B. ell
   C. eff
   D. bay

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Tochter"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

13. What does "die Tür" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. pot
   B. kitchen
   C. plate
   D. door

14. What does "das Badezimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. clock
   B. bathroom
   C. pot
   D. door

15. What should you do first when reading a text for comprehension? (1 mark)
   A. Copy the whole text
   B. Guess the answers
   C. Read only the last line
   D. Look at the title and pictures

16. Which two words is "Wochenende" made from? (1 mark)
   A. Woche and Ende
   B. Wochen and Tag
   C. Woche and Tag
   D. Tag and Ende

17. Which day comes right before Freitag? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Montag

18. Which German word means "yesterday"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. morgen
   B. gestern
   C. jetzt
   D. heute

19. Which month comes right after "Juli"? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. Oktober
   C. Dezember
   D. Mai

20. Which German word is the number 8? (1 mark)
   A. acht
   B. vierzehn
   C. dreizehn
   D. fünf

21. What does "wann" ask about? (1 mark)
   A. When
   B. Who
   C. Where
   D. How many

22. Which food is usually called healthy? (1 mark)
   A. Chips
   B. Obst
   C. Zucker
   D. Limonade

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Brot"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

24. What does "das Auge" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tooth
   B. eye
   C. toe
   D. mouth

25. Which little word goes with the noun "Zahn"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

26. What does "schwarze Haare" mean? (1 mark)
   A. brown eyes
   B. black hair
   C. small feet
   D. big hands

27. Which German word means "in"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. neben
   C. vor
   D. unter

28. What does "Wo ist Oma?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where is grandma?
   B. Who is grandma?
   C. What does grandma cook?
   D. How old is grandma?

29. Which verb form completes "Mutter ___ in der Küche"? (kochen) (1 mark)
   A. kocht
   B. kochen
   C. kochst
   D. koche

30. Which German word or phrase means "see you soon"? (1 mark)
   A. Danke
   B. Bis bald
   C. Bitte
   D. Ja

31. What is the plural of "das Haus"? (1 mark)
   A. die Häuser
   B. die Hause
   C. die Haus
   D. die Hausen

32. Which German word means "to cook"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. kochen
   B. riechen
   C. sehen
   D. spielen

33. After "möchte", which form of the verb do we use? (1 mark)
   A. the -en form at the end
   B. the -st form
   C. the -t form
   D. the -e form

34. Which German word or phrase means "candle"? (1 mark)
   A. das Lied
   B. der Kuchen
   C. die Party
   D. die Kerze

35. What does "der achte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. third
   B. tenth
   C. eighth
   D. seventh

36. Which form completes "Äpfel ___ gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. bist
   B. sind
   C. bin
   D. ist

37. Which German word or phrase means "bean"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bohne
   B. die Wassermelone
   C. die Mango
   D. die Zwiebel

38. Which German word or phrase means "breakfast"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kohl
   B. die Banane
   C. der Mais
   D. das Frühstück

39. What does "unter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. in front of
   B. above
   C. on
   D. under

40. Which completes "Die Katze sitzt ___ dem Tisch" (under)? (1 mark)
   A. auf
   B. unter
   C. vor
   D. über

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain the difference in sound between "ie" and "ei" and give one example day for each. (3 marks)

42. Write three German sentences that say where things are in a house, using im or in der. (3 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: snow, brother, meat. (3 marks)

44. Unscramble the words: SICHT and TETB. Write them with their articles. (2 marks)

45. Rewrite correctly: "guten abend otieno" (2 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: daughter, orange. (2 marks)

47. Read: "In Mombasa ist es heiß." Say what it means and how to say heiß. (2 marks)

48. Explain how the umlaut changes the word Hand in the plural. (2 marks)

49. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shoulder, son. (2 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: plate, lamp, tomato, knee. (4 marks)

51. Write four short German sentences that a child could say about his or her birthday. (4 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back. (3 marks)

53. Explain how a Rückendiktat is done. (3 marks)

54. Write the German for: I cook, I sleep, I read, I play. (4 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sky, cooker. (2 marks)

56. Unscramble and write with der or die: STWECHERS. (2 marks)

57. Write a four-line dialogue in German between two friends who meet in the morning and say goodbye. (4 marks)

58. Explain why "Meine Mutter sind nett" is wrong and correct it. (2 marks)

59. Read: "Der Herd ist heiß. Das Messer ist scharf." Explain what the text warns about. (2 marks)

60. Explain how to say the letters z, w and v in German words. Give one example each. (3 marks)

61. Explain when to use "mein" and when to use "meine". Give one example of each. (3 marks)

62. Spell the name "Zawadi" using German letter names. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — family
   die Familie means family.

2. D — parents
   die Eltern means parents.

3. B — lamp
   die Lampe means lamp.

4. B — Donnerstag
   After Mittwoch comes Donnerstag.

5. B — Samstag
   After Freitag comes Samstag.

6. B — like oo
   The u in Geburtstag is said oo.

7. C — rice
   der Reis means rice.

8. C — das Badezimmer
   A shower is in the bathroom.

9. A — koo
   In German the letter Q is called koo.

10. B — fow
   In German the letter V is called fow.

11. B — ell
   In German the letter L is called ell.

12. A — die
   It is die Tochter, so the little word is die.

13. D — door
   die Tür means door.

14. B — bathroom
   das Badezimmer means bathroom.

15. D — Look at the title and pictures
   The title and pictures give clues about the topic.

16. A — Woche and Ende
   Woche = week and Ende = end, so weekend.

17. B — Donnerstag
   Before Freitag comes Donnerstag.

18. B — gestern
   yesterday in German is gestern.

19. A — August
   After Juli comes August.

20. A — acht
   8 in German is acht.

21. A — When
   wann means when.

22. B — Obst
   Fruit (Obst) is a healthy food.

23. B — das
   It is das Brot, so the little word is das.

24. B — eye
   das Auge means eye.

25. D — der
   It is der Zahn, so the little word is der.

26. B — black hair
   schwarz = black, Haare = hair.

27. A — in
   in in German is in.

28. A — Where is grandma?
   wo means where.

29. A — kocht
   With Mutter (she) the verb ends in -t.

30. B — Bis bald
   see you soon in German is Bis bald.

31. A — die Häuser
   The plural of das Haus is die Häuser.

32. A — kochen
   to cook in German is kochen.

33. A — the -en form at the end
   Ich möchte tanzen: the second verb is in the basic -en form and goes to the end.

34. D — die Kerze
   candle in German is die Kerze.

35. C — eighth
   der achte means eighth.

36. B — sind
   Äpfel is plural, so we use sind.

37. A — die Bohne
   bean in German is die Bohne.

38. D — das Frühstück
   breakfast in German is das Frühstück.

39. D — under
   unter means under.

40. B — unter
   unter means under.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: ie sounds like ee (Dienstag); ei sounds like eye (Freitag).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sound and 1 mark for correct examples.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schnee, der Bruder, das Fleisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with article.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Abend, Otieno!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for capital letters and 1 mark for punctuation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Tochter, die Orange.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: In Mombasa it is hot. heiß is said like hice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: a becomes ä, so die Hand becomes die Hände.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the vowel change and 1 mark for the plural.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schulter, der Sohn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Teller, die Lampe, die Tomate, das Knie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich bin heute zehn. Ich habe einen Kuchen. Meine Familie ist da. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: A partner traces letters on your back; you say the letters aloud and write the word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the steps: tracing, saying, writing.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ich koche, ich schlafe, ich lese, ich spiele.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Himmel, der Herd.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the article.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: Guten Morgen, Amina! B: Guten Morgen, Otieno! Wie geht's? A: Gut, danke. B: Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line with capital letters and punctuation.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: With one person we use ist. Correct: Meine Mutter ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for the correction.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cooker is hot and the knife is sharp, so we must be careful in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each warning.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: z is ts (Zahl), w is v (Wasser), v is f in most words (Vater).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound and example.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use mein with der and das nouns (mein Vater) and meine with die nouns and plurals (meine Mutter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for correct examples.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: Z (tset), A (ah), W (vay), A (ah), D (day), I (ee).
   Working / marking points: 3 marks if all letter names are correct; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.
